title: otsec.syslog/0.3 target
description: C6 forwarding target. Strict: unknown fields are rejected. Rules that need more than one field (required only on relp-tls, framing per transport, size limit per format and transport, TLS settings exactly on TLS transports, relp_window in mode A, replay_seconds in mode B, audit only on required relp-tls, client_credential_ref on required and audit targets, durable_ack exactly on required targets, acknowledgement exactly on insecure transports) are enforced by Target.Validate in Go.

class.description: Also the C5 Delivery. required only with transport relp-tls (Go rule).

trust_anchor_ref.description: A CA set used only for this platform's collectors. TODO(A3 node key ref).

spki_sha256.description: Base64 SHA-256 of the collector's SubjectPublicKeyInfo; when set, the key must match one.

client_credential_ref.description: The node's TLS client key. Required on required and audit targets (Go rule). TODO(A3 node key ref).

durable_ack.description: The passed commissioning check that the collector acknowledges only after a durable write, and how the collector was configured when it passed (since 0.2, A1 D2-9). Required exactly on required targets (Go rule).

peer_check.description: The collector checks the node's client certificate by name against a permitted-peer list (imrelp tls.authmode="name" with tls.permittedPeer), never by CA alone.

permitted_peer.description: The node certificate name the collector permits, exactly; no wildcard.

ack_after.description: The collector acknowledges only after a synchronous durable write (rsyslog: ruleset queue.type="Direct" and omfile sync="on").

acknowledgement.description: An admin's acceptance of an insecure target (tcp, udp, relp), with C1's shape. Required exactly on those transports (A1 D1-22, Go rule).

device_content.description: Whether messages carry what is derived from the device record (dtext, subj, stype, val, cat, map, summary). Absent: on for relp-tls and tls, off for insecure transports (D1-22 and its amendment).

audit.description: The target also carries the C8 audit stream. Only a required relp-tls RFC 5424 target with max_message_octets of at least 17408 (A1 D1-15, Go rule).
